body.title: Add models.security.{runner,model,effort} global-only config-catalog rows
body.summary: Add three new GLOBAL-ONLY scalar rows to config-catalog.ts, mirroring the existing models.tiers.<tier>.{runner,model,effort} row shape exactly (same {path, type, default, desc, enumValues?, group} shape as buildConfigCatalog's tierRows/effortRow pattern), under a new group label (e.g. 'Models -- security'). No byRepo variant -- per-repo config only ever picks a TIER for a role, never the model behind it.
acceptanceChecks: config-catalog.ts exposes models.security.runner (enum of FamilyId), models.security.model (string), models.security.effort (enum, optional) as global-only rows
No byRepo.* variant exists for these three keys
settings-catalog.ts surfaces the new rows the same way it surfaces models.tiers.* rows, with no changes to how models.tiers.* itself is rendered

tests.name: CONFIG_CATALOG includes models.security.runner/model/effort as global-only rows with no byRepo variant
